title: Constructive Lean 4 Kernel and Exact Zero-Float Certificates for Google Research Cogentic's Deterministic Subexponential Factoring and QNR Breakthrough
abstract: A November 25, 2026 companion preprint from Google Research's Cogentic framework proposes an unconditional deterministic subexponential general integer factoring algorithm with claimed worst-case bit complexity O(exp(3 (ln N)^(3/4))), together with deterministic subexponential order splitting and prime quadratic nonresidue (QNR) construction in O(exp(C_split (ln p)^(1/2) ln ln(p+16))). Rather than assuming peer-reviewed endorsement of the preprint's analytic pillars, we deliver an independent, explicitly scoped, zero-floating-point verification companion uniting 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 algebraic and arithmetic sub-lemmas (zero sorry, zero axiom, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings; 3 zero-axiom and 15 [propext, Quot.sound]) with a pure-stdlib Python int/Fraction 4-mode auditor (DETFACT-COGENTIC-CERT-1.0) that certifies 16 canonical finite witnesses in 0.010-1.978 ms and rejects 66/66 live adversarial forgeries with exact branch assertions (72/72 pytest checks).
